## Description

Checks run on every add/change and again on authorisation: allergy/cross-sensitivity (e.g. penicillin class), drug–drug interactions (severity levels), duplicate therapy, dose range per age/renal function where data exists (e.g. "Renal dose OK · eGFR 72"). Severe findings require an override reason; results show as chips with words, not colour only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A seeded conflict set (allergy class, interacting pairs, duplicates, out-of-range doses) triggers the expected alert in 100 % of cases (automated test; exit gate 2).
- [ ] **AC2.** Authorising with a severe alert requires an override reason, recorded and audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** Alerts state severity in words and the evidence (e.g. "Allergy: Penicillin · verified").
- [ ] **AC4.** The interaction source and version are shown in an info panel and recorded with each check result.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
